title: Job-order create options
description: Where the member may create an aUEC order through a client. Read it when the create form opens and let the member choose both units from it; empty lists mean the client offers no create. It names no member.

requestingUnits.description: The units the member may create an order on behalf of: the active units they directly belong to and are a Logistician of.

responsibleUnits.description: The Profit units that may process an aUEC order.

suggestedResponsible.description: The id of the canonical Profit area among the responsible units, to preselect; null when no create is offered.

writesEnabled.description: Whether job-order writes are switched on; while false a create answers 503 JOB_ORDER_WRITES_DISABLED.
